items.claim: Vitor Petrino was dropped three times in his decision win over Stefan Struve.
items.quote: He's coming off the decision win over Stefan Struve where he was dropped three times.

items.claim: Sergey Spivak is a much better grappler than Asplin and should be able to work in his own takedowns.
items.quote: Spivak is 10 times the grappler that Asplin is and should be able to work in his own takedowns.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder uses his height and length well on the ground and on the feet.
items.quote: He's tall, and he uses that length well on the ground and on the feet.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder has an insane jump knee that he sends right up the middle.
items.quote: he's got an insane jump knee that he sends right up the middle

items.claim: Roman Dolidze can fade as fights go on.
items.quote: he can absolutely fade as fights go on.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez averages six takedowns per 15 minutes with solid wrestling and good entries.
items.quote: Six takedowns per 15 minutes, solid wrestling, good entries.

items.claim: Gregory Rodrigues uses takedown defense to keep fights standing despite being a BJJ black belt.
items.quote: Gregory Rodrigues is an insanely powerful striker who uses takedown defense to keep fights standing. He is a BJJ black belt, but you'll never see it

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez is soft in the body and cannot take body strikes well.
items.quote: He was soft in the body... It's the body that he can't really take the beating with.
